marks.subtitle: {exam} · {section} · full marks {full}
marks.typeHint: Type the marks and press Enter to move to the next student. Type ‘a’ or tap Ab for absent.
marks.invalidTOO_PRECISE: At most two digits after the point
marks.invalidOVER_FULL: Cannot be more than the full marks ({full})
marks.submitBody: The marks of {count} students go to the office. You can still change them until the sheet is locked.
marks.blanksBody: {n, plural, one {{count} cell has no marks yet} other {{count} cells have no marks yet}}. Enter the marks or mark absent before submitting.
marks.incomplete: Not submitted: {n, plural, one {{count} cell is} other {{count} cells are}} empty.
marks.rosterChanged: The student list changed: {added} added, {removed} removed. The list is updated; check it and submit again.
marks.lockedForTeacher: This mark sheet is locked. Ask the office to change it.
marks.lockedForAdmin: This mark sheet is locked. Use Correct (with a reason) to change a mark.
marks.archived: The exam is archived; marks can no longer change.
marks.offlineDraft: No connection. The marks are kept on this phone and will be sent when you're back online.
marks.conflictTitle: Someone else changed this mark sheet
marks.conflictBody: {name} changed the marks at {time}. Which version do you keep?
marks.syncRetrying: Not sent; trying again in {seconds} s

sheetAdmin.lockBody: Once locked, the teacher can no longer change it. Later changes need a correction with a reason.
sheetAdmin.returnBody: The sheet goes back to draft. Say what needs fixing; the teacher sees it.
sheetAdmin.unlockBody: The teacher can change the marks again. The reason is kept in the history.
sheetAdmin.correctBody: Change one mark on a locked sheet. A reason is required and kept in the history.
